timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
timeline.zh: 嗨！今天我能帮您什么忙？

timeline.zh: 是的，你好，所以问题是。我需要知道在线有多少T恤可用。比如，你们有多少件？

timeline.text: I'd be happy to help you check the availability of t-shirts! Let me first look up what t-shirt products we have available.
timeline.zh: 我很乐意帮您查询T恤的库存情况！让我先查一下我们目前有哪些T恤产品可用。

timeline.text: Great! I can see we have T-Shirts available. Let me check the specific details and availability for our T-Shirt product.
timeline.zh: 太好了！我看到我们有T恤可用。让我检查我们T恤产品的具体细节和库存情况。

Now, I have some pending orders for small t-shirts. I want to change them all to purple, same size, same v-neck, and prefer polyester. How many of those specific ones do you have?
